description:
Move a transcription to the trash, with its recordings, transcript, translations and summary; its share links stop working.
Use: to remove one; undo with update_transcription restore true (list_transcriptions with lifecycle archived lists the trash). Saved speakers stay (delete_speaker). A broadcast itself: delete_broadcast.
Arguments: transcriptionId only: the transcriptionId field returned by create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast, a 36-character UUID, upper or lower case. Not a name (look it up with search_transcriptions), a broadcastId or a speakerId (not_found), nor the code in a share link (invalid_options: it must be a UUID).
Behaviour: free; a soft delete kept 30 days, then erased for good. At once its share links answer not found, voices reading its translations stop, and it leaves list_transcriptions and search_transcriptions; restoring brings back the same links. A file still being transcribed is stopped and keeps its text so far, billed only for that; restoring does not resume it. A live one must be stopped first (update_broadcast with onAir false on its broadcast). One already in the trash is left as it is, so a retry is safe. Needs a key or token with the write scope; a read-only one is refused before anything changes. Gives rate_limited (with retryAfterS) past 600 calls a minute per API key.
Returns: transcriptionId, name, deleted, deletedAt, restorableUntil.
Errors: invalid_state while recording live or when locked; not_found; forbidden for a read-only key.

transcriptionId.description: A transcriptionId from list_transcriptions or create_transcription.

name: delete_transcription
title: Delete a transcription
